MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, or 64%—Internal Rotation; leadership is Broad (Top 5 span 4 sectors). Positive breadth is offset by negative Financials and Communication sector returns and major stock-level divergences, so signals do not support a stronger regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead on the week: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.34% | 1M: +23.61%) and PPG ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +11.71%). Real Estate and Industrials follow by sector return; CCI ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +30.82%) and LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%) show strong individual momentum.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication is weakest: TTWO BELOW TREND (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -3.69%) and T BELOW TREND (1W: -5.52% | 1M: -14.49%). Energy and Financials are also negative on the week; PSX CORRECTION (1W: -5.62% | 1M: +8.53%) and JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.23% | 1M: +1.79%) illustrate mixed stock-level signals.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.60% | 1M: +1.57%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.34% | 1M: +23.61%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.93% | 1M: +5.29%), CCI ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +30.82%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), though the technology names are not representative of broad megacap strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: META BELOW TREND (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -17.10%), BA BELOW TREND (1W: -13.07% | 1M: -10.94%), VLO CORRECTION (1W: -11.05% | 1M: +0.20%), VST CORRECTION (1W: -8.59% | 1M: +1.34%), BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -8.87%). Weakness spans technology, industrials, energy, utilities and consumer discretionary.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W advances include LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.60% | 1M: +1.57%) and DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.34% | 1M: +23.61%). MAJOR divergence: AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.38%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +4.33%) and AMZN CORRECTION (1W: -2.96% | 1M: +3.21%); watch for trend breaks.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Sector return is positive, but megacap trends diverge: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -5.21%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -4.70%) and META BELOW TREND (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -17.10%), while PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.60% | 1M: +1.57%) and ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.93% | 1M: +5.29%). Sector breadth: 24 stocks; constituent-level positive count was not provided.

8. Financials Outlook?
The sector was slightly negative on the week, while JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.23% | 1M: +1.79%) contrasts with payment names V CORRECTION (1W: -1.78% | 1M: +9.49%) and MA CORRECTION (1W: -1.98% | 1M: +8.46%). Sector breadth: 20 stocks; constituent-level positive count was not provided.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Sector return is positive, with LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +8.75%) and JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +1.30%) offset by MRK BELOW TREND (1W: -5.97% | 1M: -5.59%). Sector breadth: 17 stocks; constituent-level positive count was not provided.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Stance?
Favor select relative strength rather than make a broad style shift: LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%) and DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.34% | 1M: +23.61%) stand out, while megacap technology is mixed. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; major divergences argue for measured exposure and confirmation.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%) and PPG ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +11.71%)—watch for follow-through after positive catalysts. BEARISH: META BELOW TREND (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -17.10%) and BA BELOW TREND (1W: -13.07% | 1M: -10.94%)—weakness persists unless momentum stabilizes.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (+1.83% on the week) and Industrials (+1.13%) led among the 7/11 positive sectors; monitor whether gains broaden. BEARISH: Communication (-2.66%) and Energy (-0.75%) lagged; Financials was also slightly negative (-0.17%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied. Watch whether LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%) and ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.93% | 1M: +5.29%) sustain their advances, and whether META BELOW TREND (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -17.10%) and BA BELOW TREND (1W: -13.07% | 1M: -10.94%) stabilize.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LMT (+55): reported major defense deal; LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%) confirms the positive catalyst. PPG (+55): earnings beat and higher guidance cited; PPG ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +11.71%) also confirms sentiment. Other positive headlines in the feed lacked matching 1W/1M stock data here, so price confirmation cannot be assessed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-35): South Korea fined Apple and Google over app-payment practices; AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.38%) shows mild near-term weakness against a positive monthly return. The other leading negative headlines lacked matching 1W/1M stock data here, limiting price-action confirmation.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with mixed style leadership; breadth is 7/11 sectors positive and Top 5 leadership is Broad across 4 sectors. LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%) and DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.34% | 1M: +23.61%) show relative strength. Major megacap divergences and META’s sharply negative trend warrant monitoring; bullish LMT news is confirmed by price action.
